steps.question: 近30天各渠道ROI：已支付销售额除以投放花费，两表各自按渠道汇总后计算，按ROI降序
steps.sql: SELECT m.channel AS "渠道", ROUND(COALESCE(o.sales, 0) / NULLIF(m.spend, 0), 2) AS "ROI" FROM (SELECT channel, SUM(spend) AS spend FROM marketing_spend WHERE spend_date BETWEEN '2026-01-30' AND '2026-02-28' GROUP BY channel HAVING SUM(spend) > 0) AS m LEFT JOIN (SELECT channel, SUM(paid_amount) AS sales FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-30' AND '2026-02-28' GROUP BY channel) AS o ON o.channel = m.channel ORDER BY "ROI" DESC

steps.question: 本月各渠道ROI：已支付销售额除以投放花费，两表各自按渠道汇总后计算，按ROI降序
steps.sql: SELECT m.channel AS 渠道, ROUND(COALESCE(o.sales, 0) / NULLIF(m.spend, 0), 2) AS ROI FROM (SELECT channel, SUM(spend) AS spend FROM marketing_spend WHERE spend_date >= '2026-02-01' AND spend_date <= '2026-02-28' GROUP BY channel) AS m LEFT JOIN (SELECT channel, SUM(paid_amount) AS sales FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND order_date >= '2026-02-01' AND order_date <= '2026-02-28' GROUP BY channel) AS o ON o.channel = m.channel WHERE m.spend > 0 ORDER BY ROI DESC
